help.start.title: Getting started and home
help.start.intro: Interra LeadFlow brings leads, customers, tasks and sales opportunities into one workspace. Follow this guide to learn each workflow step by step.
help.start.overview.title: Start with the overview
help.start.overview.step1: Select Home in the sidebar or press the Interra logo. Summary cards show counts from your current records.
help.start.overview.step2: Review tasks due today and overdue tasks under priority tasks. Use Tasks and Calendar in the sidebar to manage them.
help.start.overview.step3: Start a new business relationship by adding a lead. Schedule contact as a task, track commercial progress as an opportunity and keep existing customers in Customers.
help.start.overview.tip: In this version, lead, customer, task, opportunity and demo email changes reset on refresh. Language, theme and profile are stored in the browser. Guide records are examples.
help.leads.title: Leads
help.leads.intro: Track hotels, architecture offices and other businesses that are not yet customers. Each lead holds company and contact information.
help.leads.list.title: Find and filter records
help.leads.list.step1: Open List in Leads. Type part of a company or contact name; results update as you type.
help.leads.list.step2: Status and Owner work together with search. If a record is missing, clear the search text and select All statuses and All owners.
help.leads.list.step3: Use ↘ at the end of a row to open lead details. Source, status and next follow-up are visible in the list.
help.leads.create.title: Add a lead
help.leads.create.step1: Press Add New Lead. Complete Company and Contact person in the dialog; both are required.
help.leads.create.step2: Add email and phone if available. Source describes where the lead came from; Status describes the relationship stage. Enter the person managing the record as Owner.
help.leads.create.step3: Press Next follow-up and pick a calendar date. Leave it empty if no follow-up is scheduled. Add initial conversation details in Notes.
help.leads.create.step4: Save lead adds the record to the list and shows a notification at the bottom right. Cancel or Close dismisses the dialog without saving.
help.leads.followup.title: Update follow-up details
help.leads.followup.step1: Check company and contact information on the page opened with ↘. Update Status under Follow-up information after a conversation.
help.leads.followup.step2: Choose the next follow-up date and record the conversation outcome in Notes.
help.leads.followup.step3: Press Save changes. Use Back to leads at the top to return to the list.
help.map.title: Map and information cards
help.map.intro: Explore leads with locations by district. This version uses sample positions representing districts of Istanbul.
help.map.explore.title: Find a company on the map
help.map.explore.step1: Choose Map in Leads. Company search and District on the left filter both the list and markers.
help.map.explore.step2: Hover over a marker to show company, contact and communication details in a small white card. On touch devices, tap the marker or company in the list.
help.map.explore.step3: After selecting a company, open its details with ↘ below the map. Use the map’s + / − controls to zoom.
help.map.explore.tip: New leads do not automatically receive a location; only located records are shown. Markers are not actual company addresses. Check your internet connection if map tiles fail to load.
help.customers.title: Existing customers
help.customers.intro: Keep existing customers and campaign contact details here. Changing a lead’s status does not automatically create a customer record.
help.customers.create.title: Create a customer record
help.customers.create.step1: In Customers, press New Customer. Enter the company and contact person.
help.customers.create.step2: Add email, phone, city and owner. A valid email address is needed to select the customer for a campaign email.
help.customers.create.step3: Write key relationship details in Notes and press Save customer. The new record appears in the customer list.
help.customers.edit.title: Edit customer details
help.customers.edit.step1: Search by company, contact, communication details or city. Filter by owner to see one person’s customers.
help.customers.edit.step2: Press ↘ on the relevant row. Edit the required field in the prefilled form.
help.customers.edit.step3: Save changes updates the existing record. Cancel discards your edits.
help.tasks.title: Tasks and calendar
help.tasks.intro: Plan calls, meetings and site visits. Follow dates on the calendar and progress in the task list.
help.tasks.create.title: Create a scheduled task
help.tasks.create.step1: Press New Task. Describe the action in Task title and select Call, Meeting, Site visit or Other as its type.
help.tasks.create.step2: Pick a date. Time is optional; choose hours and minutes separately. No time saves a task with only a date.
help.tasks.create.step3: Select a related lead or leave it as a standalone task. Add preparation details in Notes and press Save task.
help.tasks.date.title: Choose a month and year directly
help.tasks.date.step1: The Date field opens a small calendar. Use its month and year selectors to jump directly to a period rather than moving through each month.
help.tasks.date.step2: Selecting a day closes the calendar and fills the date. Choose today fills today’s date. Close calendar dismisses it without changing the selection.
help.tasks.date.step3: On the main calendar, press the month and year text to choose a period. Previous and next arrows move one month at a time.
help.tasks.track.title: Track and complete tasks
help.tasks.track.step1: Small calendar icons indicate task types. Select a day to show its tasks in the list on the right.
help.tasks.track.step2: Use Show tasks to switch between Pending, Today, Overdue, Completed and All. All dates removes the selected-day restriction.
help.tasks.track.step3: Check a task to complete it; uncheck to reopen it. A completed task may disappear under the current filter; find it under Completed.
help.tasks.manage.title: Edit, add notes or delete
help.tasks.manage.step1: Right-click a day containing tasks. If it has several tasks, each has its own action group.
help.tasks.manage.step2: Edit task opens the form; Add note focuses the notes field. Save your changes before leaving.
help.tasks.manage.step3: Delete task asks for confirmation. Check the title and confirm or cancel. On mobile, access the same actions through Edit on the task card.
help.campaigns.title: Campaigns and email
help.campaigns.intro: Review available campaigns, choose existing customers and preview email content. Sending is demo-only in this version.
help.campaigns.browse.title: Choose a campaign
help.campaigns.browse.step1: Find a campaign using search and status filters. Review its channel, dates and status on the card.
help.campaigns.browse.step2: The ↘ button at the bottom of the card opens campaign details.
help.campaigns.detail.title: Compose from campaign details
help.campaigns.detail.step1: Review start and end dates, owner, budget and spending in the details dialog.
help.campaigns.detail.step2: Press Prepare Email. Demo send history shows sends prepared for this campaign in the current session.
help.campaigns.recipients.title: Choose recipients and write the message
help.campaigns.recipients.step1: Search among existing customers. Check the customers you want to include.
help.campaigns.recipients.step2: Select eligible visible customers adds only currently visible customers with valid emails. An address shared by two records counts as one recipient.
help.campaigns.recipients.step3: Edit Subject and Message. Select a recipient before previewing; update missing email addresses in Customers first.
help.campaigns.preview.title: Review the preview
help.campaigns.preview.step1: Press Preview and check recipients, subject and message. Return to editing to change them.
help.campaigns.preview.step2: Complete demo send adds an entry to the campaign’s session history. No real email is sent to customers.
help.sales.title: Sales opportunities
help.sales.intro: Track proposals as separate opportunities. A lead can have more than one sales opportunity.
help.sales.create.title: Create an opportunity
help.sales.create.step1: In Sales Opportunities, press New Opportunity. Opportunity name and Lead are required, so create a lead first.
help.sales.create.step2: Enter the amount if known, otherwise leave it empty. Zero is different from an unspecified amount. Add an estimated close date and notes if needed.
help.sales.create.step3: Choose the stage and press Save opportunity. The card appears in the chosen stage column.
help.sales.stages.title: Track stages and amounts
help.sales.stages.step1: Change the stage using the selector on the card. It moves to the matching column and summaries update.
help.sales.stages.step2: Search and lead-owner filters work together. Top-level amounts reflect the active filters.
help.sales.stages.step3: Scroll the sales board horizontally to see all stages. Marking an opportunity won or lost also changes the reports.
help.reports.title: Reading reports
help.reports.intro: Reports summarize current session records. They do not compare historical periods or date ranges.
help.reports.read.title: Understand distributions and sales results
help.reports.read.step1: Check lead, existing customer, open opportunity and active campaign counts in the top cards.
help.reports.read.step2: Status and source distributions show lead counts and shares. Update source in lead records and status in follow-up details.
help.reports.read.step3: Review open and won amounts, unspecified amounts and win rate in the sales summary. The rate cannot be calculated until there are closed opportunities.
help.reports.read.step4: Task tracking shows overdue and pending work. A zero or empty result is not necessarily an error; the relevant records may not exist yet.
help.settings.title: Language and appearance
help.settings.intro: Choose your interface language and theme. Preferences do not change the contents of your records.
help.settings.preferences.title: Turkish/English and light/dark theme
help.settings.preferences.step1: Choose Türkçe or English under Language in Settings. Menus, dates and number formats update immediately.
help.settings.preferences.step2: Press Appearance to switch between light and dark themes. Dialogs use the same theme.
help.settings.preferences.step3: Preferences are saved in the browser. Company names, user notes and email content are not automatically translated.
help.profile.title: Account menu and profile
help.profile.intro: View and edit your profile through the account menu at the top right. Your profile is separate from customer records.
help.profile.menu.title: Open the account menu
help.profile.menu.step1: Open Account settings from the user menu at the top right. Sign out is also available in this menu.
help.profile.menu.step2: Switch between Profile information and Security within Account settings.
help.profile.view.title: View your existing profile
help.profile.view.step1: Review name, email, phone, city and country under personal details. Company, department and title appear under work information.
help.profile.view.step2: Empty fields display Not specified. On first use, an example demo profile is shown.
help.profile.edit.title: Update your profile
help.profile.edit.step1: Press Edit. The form opens with your existing details. Full name is required; complete contact and work information as needed.
help.profile.edit.step2: Add a short introduction under About me. Save updates the information and returns to the profile view.
help.profile.edit.step3: Cancel returns to the existing profile without saving edits. The profile is stored in the browser; it is not linked to a real user account yet.
help.security.title: Security and sign out
help.security.intro: Security previews the password change flow. Real authentication and session management are not connected in this version.
help.security.password.title: Understand password and sign-out flows
help.security.password.step1: Open Account settings from the user menu and choose Security. Enter the current and new passwords. Do not use your real password in this preview.
help.security.password.step2: The new password must have at least 15 characters, match its confirmation and differ from the current password. Show/hide only changes field visibility.
help.security.password.step3: Update password currently only validates the form; no password is stored, sent or changed. Cancel resets the fields.
help.security.password.step4: Sign out replaces the workspace with an exit preview. Return to demo brings it back and preserves this tab’s records. It is not a real account sign-out.

help.charts.intro: Explore leads, sales, tasks and customer distribution in six charts. Charts reflect your current records.
help.charts.read.title: Read the home charts
help.charts.read.step1: Hover over a segment or legend row in the lead and task rings; the center shows the selected group. You can also focus legend rows using the keyboard.
help.charts.read.step2: Home shows lead status, sales stages and task progress charts. Figures are calculated from current records.
help.charts.read.step3: Use Count/Amount in Sales stages to switch between opportunity count and known total values. Unknown amounts are indicated separately and excluded from amount totals.
help.charts.read.step4: Add a record and return Home to see updated charts. Empty charts explain which records to add and link to the relevant section.
help.charts.read.tip: Overdue tasks are counted separately from pending tasks. Charts show current records, not historical growth or revenue.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Save a copy of your data to a file or restore a backup.
backup.scope: Includes leads, customers, tasks, opportunities and demo email records. Fixed campaigns, profile, language and theme are not included.
backup.keepFile: Keep the JSON file to restore your data later.
backup.downloadError: Could not create the backup file. Please try again.
backup.invalid: This is not a valid Interra LeadFlow backup or exceeds 10 MB. Your records were not changed.
backup.localNote: This is a manual file backup, not cloud storage or autosave. Records reset on refresh; restore them from the file. Store it safely as it contains customer information.
backup.replaceWarning: This replaces all current records with the backup. Counts below show current → backup.
backup.beforeRestore: To keep your current records, cancel and download a backup first.
backup.restoredHint: Records from the file are available in this session.
